subtitle: Out Manila · Air Changan
overview: Take the charter flight to Yichang with Air Changan, then drive to Zhangjiajie for Baofeng Lake and the Avatar scenic area (Zhangjiajie National Forest Park). You return to Yichang for a cruise at the Yangtze River Three Gorges Tribe scenic area before flying home. Hotels are Ramada in Zhangjiajie and Yichang, or similar.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 2–5 2026 to Dec 28–31 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Baofeng Lake: A mountain lake in Zhangjiajie surrounded by peaks and waterfalls; the visit includes a cruise.
placeDesc.72 Wonder Buildings: An optional stop at the 72 Wonder Buildings in Zhangjiajie, a tall stilt-shaped building complex.
placeDesc.Tianmen Mountain: A mountain near Zhangjiajie reached by cable car, with a glass walkway and Tianmen Cave; an optional tour.
placeDesc.Zhangjiajie Avatar Scenic Area: A national forest park of tall sandstone pillars, linked to the scenery of the Avatar movie.
placeDesc.Bailong Lift: A large outdoor glass elevator that carries visitors up the cliff face at Zhangjiajie.
placeDesc.No.1 Bridge: A natural stone bridge in Zhangjiajie, a viewpoint within the Avatar scenic area.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: A floating-style sandstone peak in Zhangjiajie that is linked to the Avatar movie scenery.
placeDesc.Breath-taking Platform: A viewing platform in the Zhangjiajie scenic area overlooking the sandstone pillars.
placeDesc.West Sea Clouds: A scenic viewpoint in the Zhangjiajie area known for cloud-covered peaks.
placeDesc.Grand Canyon Glass Bridge: A glass-bottomed bridge over a deep canyon near Zhangjiajie; an optional tour.
placeDesc.Yangtze River Three Gorges Tribe: A scenic area near Yichang on the Yangtze River with Tujia culture; the visit includes a cruise.
placeDesc.Qu Yuan’s Hometown: The area near Yichang associated with the ancient poet Qu Yuan.
placeDesc.San You Cave: A limestone cave and scenic gorge area near Yichang, visited as a sightseeing stop.
